bromatological.title: Bromatological Analysis
bromatological.description:
• Determines the nutritional composition of food and raw materials by evaluating: moisture, protein, fat, fiber and ash.
  • Detects variations between batches before they impact your process or generate economic losses.

mycotoxins.title: Mycotoxins and Protein Digestibility
mycotoxins.description:
• We detect aflatoxins, zearalenone, ochratoxin and more — even without visible signs.
  • Find out what percentage of protein the animal actually utilizes and optimize the efficiency of your ingredients.

microbiology.title: Microbiology · Type 2 Laboratory
microbiology.description:
• We are the only food laboratory in the region with Type 2 facilities.
  • We detect Salmonella and Listeria monocytogenes by PCR within hours and validate the real effectiveness of your sanitizers.

indicators.title: Microbiological Indicators
indicators.description:
• Our "Microbiological Traffic Light" assesses risk factors in your production: Aerobic Mesophiles, Yeasts, Total Coliforms and Molds.
  • Detects hygiene failures early and prevents bacterial growth risks before they impact your finished product.

about3.title: Fast, accurate and reliable NIRS analysis.
about3.description: We perform fast analyses of raw materials and balanced feed. We develop and validate specific models for your raw materials and feed, ensuring reliable results tailored to your operation.

specialists.title: Specialists in the livestock sector
specialists.description: Latest-generation NIRS technology with personalized technical support for your operation.

fastResults.title: Fast and reliable results
fastResults.description: We optimize your existing calibrations to improve precision, repeatability and reliability in every analysis.
